name: Azuma Shione
source:
She is from the same class as Yuka, Kakeru, Mio and Shuu. She had a crush on Shuu and confessed to him. However, she was rejected, as Shuu was afraid that his life of a magician would put her in danger.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/11eyes#New_characters_in_11eyes_CrossOver]Wikipedia[/url]]
